column1: # What is known not to fit in the faces pack (faces_026's gate, docs/faces-026.md), and why.
# One misfit a line, tabs between: face, state, what (the worn set it shows through, or
# "<item> stands off"), the most it may be (mm), why. The build stops on a misfit this list does
# not name, and on one deeper than it says. A torso is named once (it is worn in every state);
# a helmet over a mask is open when either of the two is, and named itself when it is deeper.
# Made by FACES_WRITE_OPEN of faces@4's build (the masks made for faces in it), 2026-11-19, the
# Novice's lines from faces@5's, over the stock db and patches 12 .. 65.
